### Concise Summary of Findings ###
- Clear goals are essential but need structured templates.
- Communication organization is improved but requires reminders for adherence.
- Timely reviews help identify gaps but need established deadlines.
- Specific actions are identified but depend on follow-up mechanisms.

These findings will guide us in enhancing our workflow in the next session.
